headline: Set up parent access
subheadline: Your account currently has fan access. Complete parent setup to use the parent portal.
noticeBody: The parent portal lets you manage a player profile and family calendar. Your account type will be upgraded to Parent. This change is recorded and cannot be undone without contacting support.

checklistItems.text: I understand my account type will be upgraded to Parent.
I confirm I am the parent or legal guardian of the player I will add.
I have read and agree to the Soccer Center data-sharing notice.

emailNotVerifiedBody: You need to verify your email address before setting up parent access. Check your inbox for a verification link.
successBody: Your account has been upgraded. You now have access to the parent portal.
